def find_groups(row):
    groups = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        if row[i] != 0:
            start = i
            color = row[start]
            j = i
            while j < len(row) and row[j] != 0:
                j += 1
            end = j - 1
            groups.append((start, end, color))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return groups

    return sum(g[1] - g[0] + 1 for g in groups[start_idx:])

    width = len(row)
    inp_g = find_groups(row)
    num_groups = len(inp_g)
